Friends list, nickname, status message, cheer messages

items.title: No terms (EULA) consent before login; no zero-tolerance clause
items.state: Social login goes straight to home. No terms screen anywhere.
items.fix: Insert a consent screen after social login (terms + privacy + age 14+ checkboxes, required). Add the zero-tolerance clause from templates/eula-ugc.md.
items.proof: First scene of the screen recording.

items.title: No way to report content or users
items.state: No report UI in friends list, profile or chat.
items.fix: Long-press / ⋯ menu → Report → reason → `reports` collection + email/Slack notification.

items.title: No block mechanism
items.fix: Profile ⋯ → Block → `blockedUsers`; filter every friends/session/message query instantly; Settings > Blocked users.
items.proof: Recording: block a user, content disappears instantly.

items.title: No objectionable-content filter
items.state: Nicknames and messages are stored as typed.
items.fix: Profanity list (ko/en) on client + server rule before save; SafeSearch for images.

items.title: Google/Kakao login without Sign in with Apple
items.fix: Add Sign in with Apple button (same size/position), enable capability + Firebase provider. Also solves reviewer-login problem (ACC-03).

items.title: No in-app account deletion
items.fix: Settings > Account > Delete account → confirm → Cloud Function deletes user doc, storage, auth; unlink Kakao/Google/Apple. Web deletion page URL for Play Data safety.

items.title: No reviewer demo account that bypasses verification
items.state: Only Google/Kakao accounts exist; both trigger 2-step verification from foreign IPs.
items.fix: Create reviewer@ / reviewer2@ email accounts (enable Email/Password provider), make them friends, seed chats. Put in App Review Information + Play App access.

items.title: Silent audio keeps the timer alive in background
items.fix: Store end time + schedule local notification + recompute on resume; Live Activity for lock screen. Remove `audio` background mode or ship a real ambient-sound feature.

items.title: Universal app; iPad layout not verified
items.fix: Run on iPad 13" simulator; constrain content width (max 600pt) or switch to iPhone-only.

items.title: FOREGROUND_SERVICE without foregroundServiceType
items.state: TimerService declared without type → crash on API 34+.
items.fix: Add `android:foregroundServiceType="specialUse"` + `FOREGROUND_SERVICE_SPECIAL_USE` permission + Play Console declaration with video.
items.proof: Play Console: Foreground service permissions form.

items.title: No PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy
items.state: UserDefaults used; no manifest → ITMS-91053 on upload.
items.fix: Add manifest with NSPrivacyAccessedAPITypes (CA92.1) and collected data types.

items.title: Privacy policy linked in app
items.state: Settings > Privacy policy opens notion page.
items.proof: Also set URL in both consoles.

items.title: Questionnaire must say 'users interact'
items.fix: Answer 'Yes' to user interaction / UGC in both questionnaires.

items.title: No digital goods sold
items.state: No IAP or external payment signals.
